title: Pivoted Profile Arm and Blind Mould Station
description: One newly authored complete static pottery profile-arm station: a broad single ground base carries a short front spindle pedestal and a separate rear twin-ear pivot tower. A continuous fore-and-aft beam passes through the horizontal pivot, with a fixed rear counterweight exterior and a full blunt curved profile plate on its front clamp. The plate is held above the open mouth of one complete thick shallow blind mould on a supported round turntable. The mould has a real continuous inner cavity and closed floor. There is no kick flywheel, seat or long open wooden frame; no vertical pressing plunger, upper die, twin-cup carrier or toggle linkage. All geometry is newly authored as one supported machine exterior, not a collection of imported props. Four opaque untextured PBR roles, metre Z-up, ground-centred. One model zero scenes. Static art only: no shaping, cutting, rotation, drive, physical counterbalance, mould compatibility, fabrication, operator fit or safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
